today.title: A TALENT FOR MURDER
today.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final instalment of the Ripley anthology.

today.title: Clayface
today.synopsis: DC Studios' first-ever foray into the genre, Clayface is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. Clayface unravels one man's horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one's identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

today.title: I Play Rocky
today.synopsis: Sylvester Stallone, then a failing actor, writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

today.title: Josephine
today.synopsis: After eight-year-old Josephine witnesses a violent assault in San Francisco?s Golden Gate Park, the trauma begins to reshape her world, and her fear and confusion slowly unravel the household around her. Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan star as her parents in Beth de Araújo?s acclaimed drama, winner of both the Grand Jury Prize and the Audience Award at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

today.title: NASZA REWOLUCJA
today.synopsis: Jacek and Grayna Kuro believe that together they can change their country. As their home becomes a meeting place for Poland?s opposition, the fight for freedom puts their family and their love under growing pressure. Imprisonment keeps them apart, and martial law brings painful choices. Against a backdrop of political repression, they struggle to protect the bond that gives their commitment its meaning.

today.title: Resident Evil
today.synopsis: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger comes a thrilling - and terrifying - reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan, a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

today.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping
today.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING revisits the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

today.title: Wicker
today.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

today.title: Wild Horse Nine
today.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone's trip to this remote paradise sideways.

today.title: You can see everything
today.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she?s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

comingSoon.synopsis: When bratty 8-year-old Kevin McCallister (Macaulay Culkin) acts out the night before a family trip to Paris, his mother (Catherine O'Hara) makes him sleep in the attic.
